title: termal_send_to_session surfaces the boot-window 423 'federation persistence is settling; retry' to agents, who must retry by hand
outcome: A native send to a remote root during the peer's boot-window durability settling does not need a manual agent retry, or the documented agent recovery is shown in the tool result. Duplicate protection by idempotency key stays unchanged.
acceptance: termal_send_to_session surfaces the boot-window 423 'federation persistence is settling; retry' to agents, who must retry by hand is done
